name: Java · Round 2
domainSummary: A statically typed language and platform compiled to portable class-file bytecode for the Java Virtual Machine, with class loading, verification, linking, managed runtime data areas, threads, garbage collection, modules, and a deep standard ecosystem.
evidenceBoundary: Use the R1 compact square base only as a scale reference. The R2 plan must expose JVM-specific layers and runtime mechanics. A cup-shaped court and three steam-like roof vents may serve as a restrained Java cultural easter egg, but do not reproduce the Java logo, wordmark, or literal coffee cup sculpture.

iterationBasis.strategy: preserve selected structural DNA and add visible domain identity

assets.name: Java · JVM Layered Keep
assets.controlledVariable: Stack clearly different source intake, class-file archive, bytecode execution, and runtime service levels on one hardware-neutral base. Use a compact strong silhouette and expose the transitions between levels through visible verifier and linker gates.
assets.thesis: Portable bytecode executed by the Java Virtual Machine.
assets.businessCue: Portable bytecode executed by the Java Virtual Machine.

assets.name: Java · Class Loader Gatehouse
assets.controlledVariable: Make loading, verification, preparation, resolution, and initialization a sequence of connected gatehouses leading into the runtime keep. Give the bootstrap loader a foundational lower gate and custom loaders smaller side gates.
assets.thesis: The class loading and linking lifecycle.
assets.businessCue: The class loading and linking lifecycle.

assets.name: Java · Bytecode Verifier Court
assets.controlledVariable: Place a guarded verification court between the class-file archive and execution hall. Use type-shape gauges, stack-height thresholds, and controlled branches as architectural mechanisms, never text or code.

assets.name: Java · Thread Stack Rotunda
assets.controlledVariable: Arrange many narrow per-thread stack towers around one large shared heap court and one method-area archive. Give each tower its own small program-counter lantern while shared services remain central.
assets.thesis: Per-thread stacks and program counters around shared JVM runtime areas.
assets.businessCue: Per-thread stacks and program counters around shared JVM runtime areas.

assets.name: Java · Generational Collector Foundry
assets.controlledVariable: Build a young allocation courtyard, an aging transfer terrace, and an old-generation archive connected by reclamation cranes and compacting rails. Make recovered space visibly return to the allocation side.
assets.thesis: Managed memory and generational garbage collection.
assets.businessCue: Managed memory and generational garbage collection.

assets.name: Java · Write-Once Bridgeworks
assets.controlledVariable: Set one class-file hall on an elevated neutral platform that connects through standardized bridges to several visibly different underlying machine foundations. Keep the upper runtime unchanged across every foundation.

assets.name: Java · Virtual Thread Hive
assets.controlledVariable: Create a dense field of tiny lightweight thread cells scheduled through a smaller carrier gallery inside the JVM keep. Preserve a shared heap and make blocking cells park in side alcoves without freezing the whole structure.
assets.thesis: Large-scale concurrency through lightweight virtual threads.
assets.businessCue: Large-scale concurrency through lightweight virtual threads.

assets.name: Java · Module Layer Citadel
assets.controlledVariable: Build a stack of strongly bounded module terraces with explicit exports, concealed internals, and narrow readable dependency bridges. Place the module graph around the runtime rather than as detached boxes.
assets.thesis: Java modules, layers, encapsulation, and reliable composition.
assets.businessCue: Java modules, layers, encapsulation, and reliable composition.

assets.name: Java · Steam Court Easter Egg
assets.controlledVariable: Carve a rounded cup-like negative-space court into the compact square building and place three slender curved ventilation stacks behind it so their wireframe exhaust paths resemble steam. Keep all forms functional and architectural rather than sculptural.
assets.thesis: A restrained coffee-culture easter egg within JVM architecture.
assets.businessCue: A restrained coffee-culture easter egg within JVM architecture.

assets.name: Java · Java Platform Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: Combine a compact JVM keep, class-loader sequence, verifier court, thread-stack towers, shared heap, collector terraces, module boundaries, portable base bridges, and the subtle steam-court easter egg. Keep the platform depth readable without becoming a city.
assets.thesis: Java as both a language and a managed portable runtime platform.
assets.businessCue: Java as both a language and a managed portable runtime platform.
